name: Cheerful!Polymorph
source:
Susan Hopkins, out of justified paranoia, bought an insurance policy in the even of any magical mishaps or supernatural problems. Joy of joys, it was a good thing she did, because she was turned into a weremongoose! Only, things don't go quite as expected when she tries to make her claim.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14639]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
苏珊·霍普金斯出于合理的偏执，购买了一份涵盖魔法事故或超自然问题的保险。万幸的是，她确实这么做了，因为她被变成了狼獴！只不过，当她试图申请理赔时，事情并没有按预期发展。

[引自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14639]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
